Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a truck driver and a chemist about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The truck driver got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the chemist scored well and was selected. Who is unintelligent?
A. The chemist
B. The truck driver
C. Can't be determined
